blocks.text: BANGA, SOUTH COTABATO, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and the Department of Education (DepEd) have joined hands to expand psychosocial first aid (PFA) for schools and communities in the wake of the campus shooting here on Sept. 18 that left three students dead and six others wounded.
